status: Exploratory saved-data analysis plan fixed before computing E/outcome associations; the source cohorts and outcomes were already reviewed. Not a confirmatory preregistration.
outcome: Among questions correct in full576, does the first captured native staged condition lose correctness? TextVQA uses full consensus credit; GQA/MMStar use their frozen correct flags.
feature_boundary: Input CLIP reconstruction errors before projection/compression; omit the ten FPS basis source positions for primary summaries. Export all-position summaries too. Decoder E is inventoried/exported but not used to predict an input-budget decision.

primary_predictor.penalty: L2 coefficient 1.0 on standardized slope coefficients, summed log likelihood; intercept unpenalized
primary_predictor.validation: Five folds assigned by seeded deterministic image-byte-hash grouping, independent of outcome. Same image never crosses train/test. Standardize using training folds only; no feature/hyperparameter search.

metrics: out-of-fold AUROC of the three-feature model
out-of-fold Brier score versus training-fold prevalence predictor
uncertainty: 1000 image-cluster bootstrap resamples of fixed scores/out-of-fold predictions; question-weighted estimand. Intervals do not include refitting/split choice, fresh native numerical variation, or independent external validation.
scope_limits: Do not pool datasets or count questions sharing images as independent images.
Small TextVQA baseline-correct denominator and few losses limit precision.
Image-only E cannot distinguish differently affected questions on the same image when their encoding is shared.
Association is not causation, a deployed adaptive-budget policy, or evidence of an improved accuracy-token tradeoff.
All outcomes remain first primary captures; no samples are retried, relabeled or removed based on prediction success.
